description: The desktop pet (#208) may read its pathless view of the drop queue (get_pet_state) to show its mood, and its quick signal (get_pet_signal: whether a file is dragged over it, and how many drops it caught; no path), ask to show the main window, the quick search window, its popup for a dropped file that waits, or the moved note for a dropped file the automatic mode moved (by the drop's ID, never a path), and be dragged to another place. Nothing else: not the full drop queue (which holds paths), no other Traeva command, no event listening (so it never sees a dropped file's path), no plugin.
